BASELINE.description: Verified honest traffic only (5 known devices)

IMPERSONATION.description: Cross-device MAC claim spoofing (detected via timing mismatch)

UNKNOWN_HARDWARE.description: Unseen commercial hardware from UNSW dataset (isolated via tau)

HIJACKED_DEVICE.description: Device compromised and swapped traffic mid-run (detected via state change)

REPLAY.description: Exact recorded target traffic replayed (passes as TRUSTED; documented timing blind spot)

scenarios.name: Impersonation Attack
scenarios.description: Rogue host sends authentic traffic of device X while falsely claiming to be device Y.

scenarios.name: Unknown Hardware Injection
scenarios.description: Rogue foreign IoT device from 15 unseen models tries to connect using a registered identity.

scenarios.name: Timing Mimicry Attack
scenarios.description: Attacker reshapes inter-arrival times toward the target distribution via quantile mapping or jitter.

scenarios.name: Hijacked Internal Host
scenarios.description: A legitimate home device operates normally, then starts sending compromised traffic mid-stream.

scenarios.name: Replay Attack (Blind Spot)
scenarios.description: Attacker captures and replays exact authentic packets of the target. Expected to PASS (academic limit).

scenarios.name: External Access Attempt (Firewall Demo)
scenarios.description: Attacker attempts direct WAN connection to internal LAN hosts; blocked by default-deny firewall.
